steps.text: Import Bring records into one Desk module from a CSV or Excel file. The file is checked before anything is written, and an import can be undone for 30 days. Import history Choose a module One module per import. The wizard maps your columns to that module’s fields and validates every row before it runs. Module Tickets CSV, XLS or XLSX up to 25 MB and 10,000 rows. Rows beyond that are left out. Start import Import several modules from a ZIP One CSV per module inside the ZIP. Each file is matched to its module by name; the imports then run one after another through the same wizard, Accounts first, then Contacts, then Tickets. Choose a ZIP file Only CSV files inside the ZIP are imported. Excel, PDF and other files are listed but left out. The ZIP must not be password protected.
